codeReview.summary: Implementation is strong on smart-case, case-flag precedence, multiline matching mechanics, word-boundary/literal handling, and zero-length progression safety, but it misses baseline-compatible precedence for conflicting multiline toggles.

issues.description: Multiline mode resolution hard-codes `--nomultiline` precedence (`if opts.multiline && !opts.no_multiline`). Since option parsing only sets booleans true for both flags (`--nomultiline` and `--multiline` in rust-ag/src/opts.rs), `--nomultiline --multiline` still executes nomultiline mode. Baseline `ag` follows last-flag-wins for this conflict, so this is a parity break within scoped multiline controls.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The rewrite-worker skill lacks an explicit upfront check for PCRE_MULTILINE vs PCRE_DOTALL behavior when implementing multiline parity.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: handoff.skillFeedback.suggestedChanges explicitly requests this addition, and the transcript skeleton shows an extended exploratory sequence to discover this baseline nuance before implementation stabilized.

summary: Review failed due to a blocking multiline flag-precedence parity mismatch (`--nomultiline --multiline`). Other scoped behavior appears well implemented and well tested.
